parts.name: Fan
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly of a ceiling fan, typically made of lightweight aluminum for efficient air movement.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to circulate air throughout the room, providing cooling and ventilation.
parts.Movement_description: The fan blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: This part appears to be a small external component or connector, likely made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It may serve as a connector or decorative cover, ensuring stability or aesthetic integration between the fan blades and the motor housing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during fan operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body or motor housing of the ceiling fan, typically made of steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the electric motor and supports the fan blades, providing the main structural and mechanical support.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed to the ceiling mount and does not move during operation.
